name: safecall
description: SafeCall — privacy-first call archive: AssemblyAI transcription + PII redaction, safe archive, AI insights on redacted data.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d redis && npx -y supabase@2.117.0 start -x studio,edge-runtime,logflare,vector,realtime,imgproxy,supavisor,postgres-meta,mailpit
scripts.infra:down: npx -y supabase@2.117.0 stop && docker compose down
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm --prefix backend run dev:api" "npm --prefix backend run dev:worker" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
